title.es: Programa Tu Horario en el Centro

message.en: The school year is getting into full swing. Tell Mr. Buchler which days and times you prefer to come on-site. Plan to come in a couple of days each week. Your schedule can stay flexible around work, sports, and other responsibilities. We look forward to seeing you in person!

fieldTripRecap.en: We had an awesome 2025-26 school year full of incredible field trips! Students explored college campuses, SeaWorld, the Birch Aquarium, Cabrillo National Monument, the San Diego Courthouse, the Museum of Contemporary Art, Mesa College, In-N-Out Burger, and many more.
fieldTripRecap.es: Tuvimos un increible ano escolar 2025-26 lleno de excursiones increibles! Los estudiantes exploraron campus universitarios, SeaWorld, el Acuario Birch, el Monumento Nacional Cabrillo, el Tribunal de San Diego, el Museo de Arte Contemporaneo, Mesa College, In-N-Out Burger, y mucho mas.

fieldTripLookAhead.en: We're looking forward to an even more robust field trip schedule next year. Stay tuned for details in the fall!
fieldTripLookAhead.es: Esperamos tener un programa de excursiones aun mas completo el proximo ano. Mantente atento para detalles en el otono!

title.es: Realidad Virtual: Exploracion de Carreras y Matematicas

content.en: State-of-the-art VR headsets at La Jolla allow students to explore careers and earn certificates in a variety of career paths. PRISMS Math in VR brings lessons to life, letting students explore difficult science and math concepts in a whole new way with hands-on problem-solving activities.

PRISMS Matematicas en VR da vida a las lecciones, permitiendo a los estudiantes explorar conceptos dificiles de ciencias y matematicas de una manera completamente nueva con actividades practicas de resolucion de problemas.

content.en: Dual enrollment lets students take real college classes while still enrolled at Charter School of San Diego. Courses are free, earn college credit when passed, are weighted on a 5-point GPA scale, and can sometimes count double for high school credit. The full guide includes recommended courses, application steps, one-on-one signup help, weekly office hours, videos, and downloadable PDFs.
content.es: La inscripcion doble permite que los estudiantes tomen clases universitarias reales mientras siguen inscritos en Charter School of San Diego. Los cursos son gratuitos, dan credito universitario al aprobar, se ponderan en una escala GPA de 5 puntos y a veces pueden contar doble para credito de preparatoria. La guia completa incluye cursos recomendados, pasos de solicitud, ayuda individual para inscribirse, horas de oficina semanales, videos y PDFs descargables.

highlights.en: Courses fill quickly, so start the signup process ASAP

highlights.en: Plan for one college class per semester unless special approval is given
highlights.es: Planea tomar una clase universitaria por semestre a menos que haya aprobacion especial

content.en: With articulation, students take courses with their Altus teacher as part of their regular coursework. If they earn an A or B, they can apply for college credit through partner colleges like MiraCosta or Southwestern. It's a great way to earn college credit without leaving the Altus classroom.
content.es: Con la articulacion, los estudiantes toman cursos con su maestro de Altus como parte de su trabajo regular. Si obtienen una A o B, pueden solicitar credito universitario a traves de universidades asociadas como MiraCosta o Southwestern. Es una excelente manera de obtener credito universitario sin salir del aula de Altus.

intro.en: Each week I share a thought, a quote, and a question to help us tackle the week with a positive and productive mindset.

attribution.en: Inspired by the James Clear 3-2-1 newsletter
attribution.es: Inspirado en el boletin 3-2-1 de James Clear

text.en: Clarity isn't about knowing what you want to do with your life, it's about knowing what you want to do this week. You don't need to have it all figured out. You just need to know your next step.
text.es: La claridad no se trata de saber que quieres hacer con tu vida. Se trata de saber que quieres hacer esta semana. No necesitas tenerlo todo resuelto. Solo necesitas conocer tu siguiente paso.

context.en: Film actress and producer Mary Pickford on protecting your mind:
context.es: La actriz y productora de cine Mary Pickford sobre como proteger tu mente:

text.en: All the water in the world cannot sink a ship unless it gets inside the ship. All the negativity in the world cannot sink a person unless it gets inside the mind.
text.es: Toda el agua del mundo no puede hundir un barco a menos que entre en el barco. Toda la negatividad del mundo no puede hundir a una persona a menos que entre en su mente.

text.en:
Instead of thinking, "What's wrong and how do I fix it?"

Try exploring, "What's right and how do I grow it?"
text.es:
En lugar de pensar, "Que esta mal y como lo arreglo?"

Intenta explorar, "Que esta bien y como puedo hacerlo crecer?"
